_about: In-game hint lines (Sal, 2026-10-31), final wording for the UI: one short friendly line per tutorial step, 12 words or fewer, each checked against what the game really does (source: TUTORIAL_FIRST_30_MIN.md and starter_goals.json). `trigger` names the moment to show it (the guide's step triggers); `goal` links a starter goal where one exists. Read by nothing yet. Keys the HUD needs: id, trigger, text.

hints.text: Walk with W A S D. Hold Shift to run.
Press Tab to see Health, Food, Water, Warmth and Energy.
Stand at the water's edge and press E to drink.
Press E to pick things up. Hold E to take everything near.
Press E on nettles or tall grass to get plant fibre.
Press I, pick Twine, and craft it from 3 fibre.
Craft a Stone axe: 1 stone, 1 stick, 2 twine.
Drag the axe to the hotbar, then press its number key.
Hold the axe and click a tree again and again.
Keep striking the fallen trunk for sticks, leaves and logs.
Craft a Campfire kit: 6 sticks and 3 stones.
Hold the kit and click where the ring shows.
Stand close and press E to light it with plant fibre.
Press E at the fire to add sticks or wood.
Hold E at the fire to roast one raw food.
Craft a Small shelter: 8 sticks, 6 leaves, 2 twine.
Click to place it, open side towards you.
Press E on ferns for bedding, then craft a Rough bed.
Place the bed under cover, then hold Z to sleep.
A Workbench: 12 sticks, 3 twine. It unlocks better tools.
Make a Wooden spear, then bind it with 2 twine.
Craft a Stone knife, then work the animal you killed.
Make a fishing rod and try the pond.
Pick berries and nuts with E. Cook them at the fire.
Warmth low: stand near a fire or put on hide clothes.
Night is dark. Craft a Basic torch: a stick and 2 fibre.
